scope: All 417 Chablis Grand Cru parcels reviewed against the pinned Chablis (89068) geometry, named areas, legal-entity rights, official DFI, DVF and Yonne notice archive. Aerial-spraying derogations identify a requester and printed treatment scope, not an owner or farmer. No current farmer is verified.

accessGaps: Four cadastral names remain without an exact climat crosswalk; the existing seven INAO climat boundaries remain authoritative. La Moutonne has no exact cadastral boundary here.

Yonne archive: 1,229 queued bulletin URLs remain missing/unusable; pre-2008 and Yonne regional farm-structure notices remain unsearched; 2024–2026 lack archived listings. Indexed 2008–2026 years are partial, not continuous coverage.
Former A11, A23 and A101 notice rows retain DFI context with unassigned treatment scope; no authorisation is transferred to a successor parcel.
Producer/company investigations are Tier 2; paid SPF copies and outreach are Tier 3. No current farmer is confirmed.

rejectedReferenceHints.89068000UR0003: UR3 on PDF pages 48 and 50 denotes a PLU zone in Auxerre (89024), not section UR parcel 3 in Chablis (89068). The Chablis word on page 53 is Route de Chablis.
